methodology: Fresh Node process per mode/scenario, forced GC before/after, identical approved GOODS evidence cloned to unique synthetic identities. Compact retains normalized features and in-memory current/history indexes. Serialized bytes sum individual record and normalized-feature JSON without allocating an entire export. Total includes warm-cache replay and first bounded query for compact; scoringMs is the comparable scoring interval. Serialization measurement is outside timed intervals. No database or embedding/model calls. One measured run per scenario; timings are observations, not service guarantees.

priorReportedBaseline.comparability: Prior measurement used a different pair mix and allocation method. This report includes a same-process-method legacy control for comparison.

correctionLedger.whatHappened: The first implementation retained unbounded notice vocabularies, and JavaScript substring views retained long notice strings; 1 x 20000 compact cold ingestion used 327.90 MiB retained heap and 30826.62 ms normalization.
correctionLedger.rootCause: Compact pair rows alone do not guarantee compact source features. Repeated large source hashing in JavaScript and retained substring backing strings dominated cold ingestion.
correctionLedger.correction: Cap retrieval-only vocabulary at 128 priority terms; detach and intern vocabulary using a bounded dictionary; use injectable native SHA-256 on the server, with identical tested browser hashes. Keep complete source hashes, original source documents and unchanged Formula operands.
correctionLedger.reusableRule: Measure normalized feature memory and one-time preprocessing separately from pair records, scoring, caching and retrieval. Never report smaller pair JSON as proof that total memory improved.
correctionLedger.regressionEvidence: tendermatch-retrieval-core.test.mjs verifies native/browser feature equality, bounded retrieval terms, unchanged Formula operands and exact 1020-pair scoring parity. Final measured corrected runs retain 62.53 MiB and 39.22 MiB respectively, including immutable input and run-history indexes. Cold 20000-source preprocessing remains a measured limitation.

limitations: No live Neon, pgvector, ANN recall or model-provider performance was measured.
The shortlist measurement is the first bounded deterministic Formula page of 50 records; semantic ANN latency/recall is not claimed.
Twenty thousand distinct source versions incur one-time feature normalization overhead; this measured cold path is slower than the legacy scoring-only loop.
Heap growth is post-GC retained memory, not peak allocation. Peak RSS is reported separately and includes the Node runtime and fixture-loading overhead.
Synthetic IDs use cloned approved source content and do not demonstrate coverage of twenty thousand distinct real procurement requirements.

corrections: Preserve geography evidence source order in operands and evidenceSnapshot hashes to match Formula v1.1 exactly, including split Central/Asia claims.
Deep-freeze normalized features; protect cache identities against mutable caller inputs.
Reject conflicting deterministic cache payloads atomically, including collisions within a batch.
Bind one immutable version of each pair to each evaluation run and support indexed historical run lookup.
Reject missing/invalid run, clock and unregistered Formula context before processing even an empty or cache-only run.
